title: Section 47 — Questions to be determined by the Court executing decree — CPC 1908

content.heading: Questions to be determined by the Court executing decree
content.text: All questions arising between the parties to the suit in which the decree was passed, or their representatives, and relating to the execution, discharge or satisfaction of the decree, shall be determined by the Court executing the decree and not by a separate suit. Where a question arises as to whether any person is or is not the representative of a party, such question shall, for the purposes of this section, be determined by the Court. Explanation: a plaintiff whose suit has been dismissed and a defendant against whom a suit has been dismissed are parties to the suit.
